reply.summary: Cilta is a scheming swindler who plans every robbery by finding a sideways route round locks and witnesses. Cilta pins the blame on respectable neighbours, but has no gift beyond a sharp, patient mind.

feats.scene: Cilta shoves a safe-door shut on a guard's hand in a panicked getaway.
Cilta tumbles down a flight of warehouse stairs and walks away bruised.

reply.summary: Liseren is a gang boss who loves inventing fresh schemes and tried to trick a famed warrior into unmasking herself. The plan collapsed, and Liseren ended up in a prison cell with a long sentence.

feats.scene: Liseren swings a cane at a rival's hat and knocks it across the alley.
Liseren takes a fist to the jaw during the arrest and stays upright.

reply.summary: Toraulrus is a masked agent of a ruthless businesswoman who wields a borrowed gadget able to fold space and fracture moments of time. A reinforced costume boosts the device, making Toraulrus a menace to any opponent.

feats.scene: Toraulrus tears open a rift beneath a bridge deck and drops half the span into it.
Toraulrus absorbs a tank shell on the boosted costume and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Siiacel is a pale-haired arms broker who designs and sells weapons through a big defence firm, then diverts stolen prototypes to street crews. Siiacel relies on henchmen and firearms rather than any power.

feats.scene: Siiacel fires a handgun at a pursuing van and shatters its windscreen.
Siiacel survives a rough tumble from a moving crate truck.

reply.summary: Rauntti is a pink, yellow-eyed lab-grown creature that gnaws through almost anything, especially timber furniture. Rauntti sees in the dark and slips unseen through hidden corridors, loyal to one young friend.

feats.scene: Rauntti chews through a thick oak table leg in a single night.
Rauntti is stepped on by a hurrying guard and scampers off unharmed.
Rauntti bolts down a service tunnel to dodge a sweeping flashlight.

reply.summary: Selli is a dark-haired metahuman raised by a cruel guardian, who broke into a vault to reclaim a locket with her mother's portrait. Selli can thicken her body, turn intangible and hit with great strength.

feats.scene: Selli punches a vault door off its hinges and sends it skidding across the floor.
Selli stands firm while a ceiling beam collapses squarely on her shoulders.

reply.summary: Vavalnau is a dark-haired gadgeteer who fights for a shadowy graveyard crew, building clever devices from scrap. Vavalnau relies on tinkered tools instead of innate power.

feats.scene: Vavalnau triggers a homemade coil that blows out a streetlamp with a loud crack.
Vavalnau is thrown against a brick wall and gets back up.

reply.summary: Iumor is an elderly antique dealer in a rough old harbour town, squeezed for protection money by rival thugs. Iumor stood up to them once, with no skill or power to back the courage.

feats.scene: Iumor shoves a bully away from the counter with both hands.
Iumor weathers a beating from three men before slumping to the floor.

reply.summary: Nalveolor is a rich property dealer turned undead feeder, ruthless in business and later fixated on making fresh brains free for all. Nalveolor endured torture and months in a dry well, then founded a congregation of the hungry dead.

feats.scene: Nalveolor drags a struggling victim across a parking lot with one arm.
Nalveolor survives a long plunge down a stone shaft and a stretch of starvation.

reply.summary: Tostle is a violet-skinned, yellow-eyed deity of death who guards the rainforest and its creatures and has no love for people. Tostle strikes bargains that cost innocent blood and then reveals their true meaning to the desperate.

feats.scene: Tostle blights a whole valley of canopy in a single night.
Tostle walks through a roaring wildfire that gutters out around the god's feet.

reply.summary: Norsirvor is a masked vigilante who borrows the abilities of creatures and was once flung decades into the past. Norsirvor was rescued by a mysterious wanderer and carried home.

feats.scene: Norsirvor kicks a gang enforcer through a plywood door.
Norsirvor survives a rooftop fall and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Neoti is a red-skinned, purple-haired son of an ancient nameless parent and brother to a goddess of strife, dwelling in a hidden fortress-city. Neoti belongs to an old race of primordial beings.

feats.scene: Neoti hurls a fractured tower into a ravine and the ground splits for a mile.
Neoti shrugs off the collapse of a cliff face.

reply.summary: Eonani is a tall young teacher and medical student who moonlights as a masked vigilante with immense strength, quick healing and a body that can turn impervious for a short while. Eonani can also release energy bursts.

feats.scene: Eonani drives a fist into a parked truck and folds its hood in half.
Eonani hardens her body and lets a speeding car rebound off her.

reply.summary: Stval is a cheerful pupil at a school for young heroes who can multiply her body density without changing size. Stval stomps to make shockwaves and becomes immovable when she piles on mass.

feats.scene: Stval stomps a courtyard and the shockwave rattles every window around.
Stval densifies and holds her ground while a wrecking ball swings into her.

reply.summary: Vossilnto is a trained medic and city vigilante who can change her mass at will, absorbing blows from bruisers and resisting energy blasts. Vossilnto also stamps the ground to send out shockwaves.

feats.scene: Vossilnto stamps once and the pavement ripples outward across a street.
Vossilnto soaks a giant bruiser's full-force punch and does not budge.

reply.summary: Veoto is a blonde newspaper writer who was coerced into guiding a gangster to a hidden island of warriors after he threatened her brother over gambling debts. Veoto has only a reporter's skills.

feats.scene: Veoto slaps a notebook against a desk in frustration.
Veoto is dragged roughly into a car by two men and shaken but unhurt.

reply.summary: Tecolau is a black-haired heiress who runs a vast family corporation and funds secret research, tasked with making sure morning always arrives. Tecolau ages far slower than ordinary people and expects a three-century life.

feats.scene: Tecolau slams a boardroom door in fury at a business partner.
Tecolau walks away from a limousine crash with a scratch.

reply.summary: Iumnel is a red-haired young woman who took a fiery curse from her sibling and now commands blazing elemental power. Iumnel hunts the dark forces behind the curse alongside monsters and misfits.

feats.scene: Iumnel hurls a ball of flame that burns a farmhouse to its foundation.
Iumnel stands inside a blazing barn as it caves in around her.

reply.summary: Ntolnel is a brilliant brain researcher and psychiatrist who built a headpiece meant to calm the minds of the very dangerous. Ntolnel speaks bluntly and has caught her employer's eye.

feats.scene: Ntolnel activates her headpiece prototype and a bench of glassware cracks.
Ntolnel is jostled by an intruder yet stays on her feet.

reply.summary: Stillri is a stranded space traveller who was raised by devout settlers and came to believe he was a heavenly warrior. Stillri flies, hits hard, is tough, and screams with sonic force.

feats.scene: Stillri bellows and a seawall crumbles along its length.
Stillri keeps fighting after a collapsing temple lands on his back.
Stillri streaks across the bay faster than sound.

reply.summary: Seooro is a clone of a dead mobster who gained a strange power after a gadget zapped him, letting him soak up the qualities of anything he touches and become that substance. Seooro works for criminals.

feats.scene: Seooro turns his arm to stone and smashes a van in half.
Seooro becomes solid steel and shrugs off a rifle volley.

reply.summary: Llium is a hired thug whose great strength only works while his feet touch the soil. Llium once joined a gang of mythology-themed criminals, and lifting him off the ground left him weak.

feats.scene: Llium plants both feet and heaves a stone statue over a fence.
Llium takes a car's full impact standing on bare earth.

reply.summary: Tantela is a living darkness, the hostile counterpart to the force that governs animal life, wanting only an end to all living things. Tantela was driven from reality once, returned, and was finally sealed in a newly made cosmos.

feats.scene: Tantela drains the life from a whole star system in a single exhalation.
Tantela is struck by the combined will of ancient guardians and is merely bound, not slain.

reply.summary: Stosil is a warrior from a harsh world who serves a tyrant, embodying hatred and rage. Stosil attacks the heroes of a divine realm with fury that never cools.

feats.scene: Stosil smashes a bunker into rubble with a roaring charge.
Stosil carries on fighting through a barrage of blaster fire.

reply.summary: Nicor is a dark-haired hotelier who built a lavish gambling palace in the middle of a rebuilt city. Nicor is under scrutiny by a keen reporter and keeps a glowing green ring.

feats.scene: Nicor thumps the roulette table to silence a heckler.
Nicor is shoved into a marble pillar and keeps his grin.

reply.summary: Stnanst is a tall, mirror-eyed tailor's nephew raised among eccentric thieves, made into a living weapon by a stolen future device that lets him steal and mimic other people's gifts. Stnanst joined the thieves' crew.

feats.scene: Stnanst copies a rival's lightning knack and fries a transformer box.
Stnanst takes a hard fall onto a parked taxi and rises.

reply.summary: Liuamo is a dark-haired city mayor who presides over civic life until a masked brute ends his term in the middle of a stadium game. Liuamo has political skill and nothing else.

feats.scene: Liuamo bangs a gavel to call a council meeting to order.
Liuamo stumbles on the podium steps and brushes himself off.

reply.summary: Stvor is a brown-haired police chief who took over from his retired father and works alongside two masked crimefighters. Stvor is father to a daughter who will one day lead a nation.

feats.scene: Stvor fires a service pistol at a fleeing car's tyre and hits it.
Stvor is knocked flat by a crook's wild swing and stands again.

reply.summary: Enuiu is a vain inventor of robots who craves wealth, fame and endless life, resentful that crowds ignore his work. Enuiu built a copying android to strike at heroes, which shorted out when dunked.

feats.scene: Enuiu orders his android to wrench a streetlight from its base.
Enuiu is hauled off to a cell without a scratch to show for his schemes.

reply.summary: Letiin is a demented robotics scientist whose creation could mimic anyone's abilities. Letiin died of an unexplained cause, leaving behind only the machine.

feats.scene: Letiin powers up a workshop robot and its arm bends a steel girder.
Letiin dusts off after a lab bench tips over.

reply.summary: Norres is a corrupt churchman who kept quiet about atrocities in exchange for a fat monthly bribe, then rose to lead a great cathedral. Norres met a violent end at the hands of a masked avenger's helper.

feats.scene: Norres cuffs a frightened prisoner across the face.
Norres is struck hard with a candlestick and collapses.

reply.summary: Tertesvi is a former sports champion who suffered terrible headaches and was turned into a wolf-man by a serum. Tertesvi fled to the cold north, hunting game, and later accepted help from a masked detective.

feats.scene: Tertesvi rakes his claws across a steel dumpster and rips it open.
Tertesvi is hit by a bolt of lightning and walks it off.

reply.summary: Reolennu is a rich, blue-eyed legislator who secretly ran a smuggling ring while his adopted daughter fought as a costumed teen. Reolennu was exposed when she discovered his crimes on a trip.

feats.scene: Reolennu pounds a desk during a heated phone call.
Reolennu tumbles on an icy walkway and is only winded.

reply.summary: Terresrn is a polite, wordy slum kid who grew into a gene scientist and helped clone his old gang. Terresrn was looked after by a kindly police officer who secretly fought crime.

feats.scene: Terresrn swings a rolled newspaper bundle and topples a street stall.
Terresrn takes a hard shove from a bigger boy and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Stutasia is a short, brown-eyed lab-grown boy with a big vocabulary who drives the gang's flying car and fixes electrical gear. Stutasia helped free a captive clone from his underground prison.

feats.scene: Stutasia heaves a crate against a security door to jam it.
Stutasia gets thrown into a pile of crates and bounces back up.

reply.summary: Ntronium is a mercenary captain who leads a crew of well-armed sea and land raiders, strengthened by a chemical booster. Ntronium kidnaps, extorts and smuggles, and was finally jailed by an arrogant rival.

feats.scene: Ntronium lifts a cargo crate overhead and hurls it at a pursuing dinghy.
Ntronium takes a rifle butt to the ribs and laughs.

reply.summary: Ilesiela is a white-haired convict who broke out of jail during a dictatorial era, remarkable for taking repeated super-fast blows without falling. Ilesiela is a living wall of metal.

feats.scene: Ilesiela drives a girder-hard fist through a prison wall.
Ilesiela endures a blur of rapid strikes and remains standing.

reply.summary: Tiliuniu is a hulking steelworker whose body became living metal after a plunge into molten alloy, giving great strength and toughness, though oxygen makes him rust. Tiliuniu runs with a gang of costumed thieves.

feats.scene: Tiliuniu pounds a loading crane and bends its arm to the ground.
Tiliuniu stands in the path of a runaway freight cart and stops it.

reply.summary: Amani is a black-haired boss of a sprawling criminal syndicate in a gloomy city, ruling through fear and orders. Amani has leadership but no fighting gift.

feats.scene: Amani slaps a lieutenant across the cheek in a smoky back room.
Amani takes a clumsy blow from a rival and glares back.

reply.summary: Loramotas is a blue-eyed racketeer who cut a trapeze rope when a circus refused to pay protection. Loramotas was later arrested, then abandoned to his own bosses' gunmen.

feats.scene: Loramotas fires a pistol into a rope and the swing drops.
Loramotas is rattled around in a prison van but stays conscious.

reply.summary: Amnaulor is a grey-haired explorer-warrior whose soul was trapped in a cursed blade and called up by a vengeful gang leader. Amnaulor briefly fought a team of masked heroes before returning to the sword.

feats.scene: Amnaulor swings a heavy axe and splits a wooden gate.
Amnaulor shrugs off a thrown knife that passes through his chest.

reply.summary: Stnasau is a short, brown-eyed ancient chieftain, regarded as the first true hero, who taught compassion in a brutal world. Stnasau hunted for his people and hurled stones at a cosmic invader.

feats.scene: Stnasau hurls a boulder-sized rock and drops a charging mammoth.
Stnasau survives a cave-bear mauling and a long winter trek.

reply.summary: Cournsia is a demonic hybrid child engineered to bring about the end times, born of an infernal spirit and a human mobster. Cournsia was cut down with an axe by a scruffy occultist.

feats.scene: Cournsia flings a delivery truck into a shop front with a sweep of a clawed arm.
Cournsia shrugs off a barrage of bricks and a thrown bottle.

reply.summary: Llantite is a huge, long-lived alien hunter who tracks famous champions with advanced weapons, once capturing one and posing as him. Llantite finally listened to the champion's friends and vowed to atone.

feats.scene: Llantite fires a hunting cannon and a warehouse folds in on itself.
Llantite stays upright after a hail of rifle fire.

reply.summary: Seaul is a red-eyed conqueror who betrayed his own cosmic race, feeding on annihilated realities until he grew immense. Seaul waged a campaign that wiped out countless universes before being stopped at terrible cost.

feats.scene: Seaul unleashes a wave of dark radiance that erases a cluster of whole universes.
Seaul weathers the combined assault of a thousand galaxies' champions.

reply.summary: Luorco is a white-eyed, pale cosmic being in a cartoonish world of tiny heroes, acting as the opposite of a gentler counterpart. Luorco lives in a toy-sized town and plays more than destroys.

feats.scene: Luorco stomps a sandbox flat and shakes the playground.
Luorco is dropped from a slide and bounces without a mark.

reply.summary: Lermi is a black-haired officer on a sheltered island of warrior women, eager to repel invaders and surprised by talk of peace. Lermi has blessed strength and toughness, and is skilled with a blade.

feats.scene: Lermi cleaves a rowing boat in two with a single sword stroke.
Lermi stands against a charging war-horse and holds the line.

reply.summary: Lleirnnau is a brown-haired fighter of an island tribe, trained in the bow, saddle and sword and blessed by two goddesses. Lleirnnau fell protecting the shore from monsters of the deep.

feats.scene: Lleirnnau looses an arrow that pins a raider's shield to a mast.
Lleirnnau holds a surf-battered ridge against a lashing tentacle.

reply.summary: Vosvalam is a blue-eyed ruler of an early sisterhood devoted to the hunt goddess, skilled at stealth and command. Vosvalam carries a truth-binding rope and a bow, and welcomed the founder of a later kingdom.

feats.scene: Vosvalam shoots an arrow clean through a bronze shield.
Vosvalam stands against a stampeding herd on a mountain pass.

reply.summary: Varen is a green-eyed rocket engineer recruited to sabotage a space programme, causing a fatal capsule explosion and later trapping reporters in a chemical blast. Varen was betrayed and died when her helicopter blew up.

feats.scene: Varen rigs a launch pad with charges and the booster erupts in flame.
Varen braces against a lab blast door that slams on her arm.
